labs.name: Delphi research group
labs.description: Official CMU profile for Roni Rosenfeld states that he co-founded and co-leads the Delphi research group since 2012, which has been named a National Center for Epidemic Forecasting by the U.S. CDC. Official research focus is tracking and forecasting epidemics.
labs.research_summary: Epidemiological forecasting methods, metrics, and data sources, including influenza and dengue forecasting.
